However, the Freiburg goalkeeper could only parry the ball into the path of Mario Dorgeles , who reacted quickest to the loose ball and fired home with his left foot to ignite celebrations in the stands. Despite a late offside call against Philipp Treu and a brief stoppage for an injury, SC Braga held firm through the final seconds. Dorgeles Breaks the Deadlock The match began with SC Braga looking to dictate the tempo through sustained possession and clever wing play. Their persistence paid off in the 23rd minute when a sequence of intricate passing carved open the visitors' defense. Leonardo Lelo provided the spark with a pinpoint key pass that found Rodrigo Zalazar , who in turn set up Mario Dorgeles . With a composed right-footed strike, Dorgeles found the back of the net to give the home side the lead. This opening goal shifted the momentum, forcing Estoril Praia to abandon their conservative shape and push higher up the pitch. As the first half progressed, the physical nature of the football on display became evident as the referee was forced to reach for his pocket multiple times. Gabriel Moscardo and Demir Tiknaz both saw yellow cards for heavy challenges, while Estoril ’s Xeka was booked for a dangerous tackle. Despite the rising tension and several set-piece opportunities, including a Rodrigo Zalazar free kick that whistled wide, Braga headed into the tunnel with their slim advantage intact. Braga introduced Luisinho for Zalazar , while Estoril brought on Andre Lacximicant to bolster their attacking options. The game nearly took a decisive turn in the 58th minute when the referee paused play for a lengthy VAR review regarding a potential penalty for Estoril . While the visitors grew in confidence following the review, they struggled initially to find the final ball, with Yanis Begraoui and Lacximicant both caught in the offside trap during promising breaks. As the clock ticked toward the final ten minutes, the pressure from the away side finally told. In the 79th minute, a rare defensive lapse from Carvalho allowed Ricard Sanchez to seize the ball and fire a cross into the path of Yanis Begraoui . The goal silenced the home crowd and set the stage for a frantic finale where both teams had a chance to snatch all three points. A Frantic Finish in Braga The closing stages were a whirlwind of activity as SC Braga threw everything forward in search of a winner. Minutes later, Carvalho saw his own headed effort blocked by a resilient Estoril backline. The tension boiled over in stoppage time as Luisinho received a yellow card for a reckless challenge on Antef Tsoungui , and Lukas Hornicek was forced into a late claim to deny a shot from Alejandro Marques . Ultimately, neither side could find the decisive blow before the final whistle. The sports drama concluded with the points shared, leaving Braga to rue their missed opportunities while Estoril celebrated a hard-earned result on the road. The result reflects a balanced battle where both tactical execution and individual moments of brilliance took center stage.
